salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-1 (b-openai + c-openai). Compact-Bench: what context compaction costs long-horizon coding agents. The four OpenAI summarizer backbones (GPT-5.6-Luna, GPT-5.6-Sol, GPT-5.6-Terra, GPT-6-Astra) of Table 2 (Task Preservation damage: round 1 and stable, among 22 validated PRE-pass repairs; the research line held round 1 and the Table-4 detail retention) and of Table 4 (Recurring-Detail Retention score; Astra is not in that table). The evaluated model is the SUMMARIZER (compaction role) under the Claude Code prompt with Kimi-K3 as the fixed continuation agent: not a coding-ability score. Damage: lower is better. Models are called through a metered gateway (OpenAI chat-completions or responses endpoint); runs in September-October 2026 (partly before 15 Oct 2026); thinking-style models at default settings. The HTML copy is held in the b-moonshot evidence folder.
